rules.description: Employee's gross monthly wages must not exceed Rs. 21,000/month for standard ESI coverage eligibility (see R_ESIC_002 for the higher ceiling applicable to persons with disability).
rules.user_friendly_explanation: Your gross monthly salary (basic + dearness allowance + regular allowances, but not overtime/bonus) must be Rs 21,000 or less.
rules.pass_message: Wage is within the Rs 21,000/month ceiling.
rules.fail_message: Wage exceeds the Rs 21,000/month ceiling, so you are not newly eligible for ESI coverage (unless the Rs 25,000 disability ceiling applies, or you are continuing coverage mid-contribution-period).

rules.description: If the employee is a person with disability (PwD), the applicable wage ceiling is raised to Rs. 25,000/month instead of Rs. 21,000/month.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: If you have a disability, your salary limit for ESI eligibility is higher - Rs 25,000 instead of Rs 21,000.
rules.pass_message: Disability status noted - Rs 25,000/month ceiling applies instead of Rs 21,000.
rules.fail_message: Not applicable - standard Rs 21,000 ceiling applies.
rules.unknown_message: Disability status not provided - standard Rs 21,000 ceiling will be applied by default; please confirm if this does not apply to you.

rules.description: The employee must work at a factory/establishment covered under the ESI Act, 1948, in a district notified by the Central Government, employing 10 or more persons (in most States/UTs).
rules.user_friendly_explanation: Your employer's workplace needs to have at least 10 employees and be registered under the ESI scheme.
rules.pass_message: Establishment meets the minimum employee-count threshold.
rules.fail_message: Establishment does not meet the minimum employee-count threshold (or is not in a notified district), so ESI coverage does not apply.
rules.unknown_message: Establishment employee count was not provided.
rules.verification_notes: A higher threshold (20 employees) is reported by secondary sources for some states (Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Odisha, Chandigarh) but this state-wise variation could NOT be confirmed against an official ESIC notification in this research pass - see conflicts.json CONFLICT_004.

rules.description: Coverage under the ESI Act applies to employees on an employer's payroll at a covered establishment; self-employed individuals, freelancers, and gig/platform workers not on a payroll are not covered under this Act.
rules.user_friendly_explanation: You need to be a regular employee on your employer's payroll - self-employed people, freelancers, and gig workers without an employer relationship are not covered by this particular scheme.
rules.pass_message: Employment type is consistent with ESI coverage (payroll employee).
rules.fail_message: Self-employed/freelance/gig work without a payroll employer relationship is not covered under the ESI Act.
rules.verification_notes: This exclusion is consistent with the structure of the ESI Act (an employer-employee contribution scheme) but was not found verbatim on an official primary document fetched in this research pass; it is sourced only to the general ESIC portal reference (SRC009) and should be confirmed against the ESI Act, 1948 text or an ESIC circular before being enforced as a hard rule.
